x_lunch_box.lore.epic: Fell open on the coach trip and rolled an apple, a yoghurt and a sandwich down the whole aisle.

x_music_box.lore.epic: Was wound up at the school concert and played so sweetly that the orchestra stopped to listen.
x_music_box.lore.rare: Plays its tune slower and slower as it winds down, until the last note takes a whole minute.

x_necklace.lore.legendary: Was found in a river after a hundred years, cleaned up, and worn to the wedding of the finder's granddaughter.

x_parcel_box.lore.rare: Arrived with one corner squashed flat and a pawprint on the lid, and the postman won't say a word.

x_pendant.lore.common: Slides round to the back of your neck every few minutes, so the gem hangs behind you.
x_pendant.lore.uncommon: Has a hidden catch, and inside is a lock of hair from a long-ago pet.

basket.lore.uncommon: Packs a picnic so neatly that there is always room for one more sandwich, and somehow one more after that.

x_eyeliner.lore.uncommon: Draws a perfect line on one eye and a wobbly moustache on the other, every single time.

x_pipe.lore.rare: Blows bubbles that refuse to pop until they've drifted over the garden fence.
